claims.assertion: Swaruu X says Earth’s human DNA combines many stellar lineages, making the planet a source for hybridization.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says some Federation groups genetically adapt Lyrian migrants’ bodies to their chosen planets, matching bodies to existing consciousness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says she lacks specific details.

claims.assertion: She describes Earth’s atmosphere and gravity as hostile to Lyrian bodies; Temmer and Alfrata are more habitable examples.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says migrants who choose new planets may receive genetic changes for local conditions; suitable worlds such as Temmer may need none.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

review_flags: Swaruu X presents multiple hybridization motives and acknowledges incomplete information about some groups.
